title: Tax-loss harvesting
summary: Same mechanics as W-2. Wash sale rules apply across all account types.
detailsHtml: Contractors should be especially attentive to the wash sale rule because they often have multiple accounts (Solo 401(k), Traditional IRA used for backdoor Roth conversions, taxable brokerage, possibly a separate spousal account). The rule applies across all of them, including spousal accounts.
